name: vic-ui
description: A quiet, dense React 19 component library: an oklch palette in light and dark, one corner scale, one elevation scale, and pieces whose state never changes their size.

scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:css
scripts.build:lib: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:design: node scripts/check-radius.mjs && node scripts/check-shadows.mjs && node scripts/check-fills.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run check:design && npm run check:dashes && npm run build
scripts.test: node --test tests/package.test.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/button.test.mjs tests/round-button.test.mjs tests/switch-variants.test.mjs tests/accent-button.test.mjs tests/colour-contrast.test.mjs tests/surfaces.test.mjs tests/native-controls.test.mjs tests/sidebar.test.mjs tests/catalogue.test.mjs tests/recipes.test.mjs tests/preview-dialog.test.mjs tests/preview-image.test.mjs tests/preview-text.test.mjs tests/inline-combobox.test.mjs tests/office-preview-parser.test.mjs tests/office-preview-browser.test.mjs tests/docx-preview.test.mjs tests/media-preview.test.mjs tests/controls-layout.test.mjs tests/density-type.test.mjs tests/motion.test.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/canonical-controls.test.mjs tests/canonical-data.test.mjs tests/canonical-pickers.test.mjs tests/canonical-tree-facts.test.mjs tests/canonical-focus-panes.test.mjs tests/canonical-focus-shell.test.mjs tests/canonical-panels.test.mjs tests/canonical-time.test.mjs tests/canonical-player-place.test.mjs tests/wrapping-row.test.mjs tests/analytics-components.test.mjs tests/trace-waterfall.test.mjs tests/table.test.mjs tests/command-mounted.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck:website: cd website && react-router typegen && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
